# Class: `CellSelectionTreeWidget`

Reports completed Cells-list mouse and keyboard selections to the main window for optional centering.

[Module](API-Module-icescopy-viewer.md) · [Source](../src/icescopy_viewer.py#L27) · [API index](API-Reference.md)

**Bases:** `QTreeWidget`.

Captures selection state before a left-mouse gesture or keyboard action and reports the completed interaction afterward. The main window decides whether Cursor mode, a changed selection, and the Auto-center setting permit navigation. Programmatic selection refreshes do not pass through these event handlers.
